proposed_widenings.name: half_damage_of_fail
proposed_widenings.justification: Burning Hands deals half damage on a successful save. This is a relative modifier on the failed-save damage, not an independent dice expression. Halving odd die counts is not representable as a DiceAmount (3d6/2 = 1.5d6, 5d6/2 = 2.5d6), and any approximation is statistically wrong. A new EffectAtom variant — or an optional flag on save_gate — is needed to express 'half of the onFail damage, rounded down.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

notes: The spell fits activation/save_gate/area(cone) cleanly except for the half-damage-on-save pattern. Range is Self; area is a 15-ft cone originating from the caster (point_within_range with a self range node). Slot scaling is linear: +1d6 fire per slot above 1. The 'flammable objects ignite' secondary effect is DM-agenda environmental state and legitimately omitted. The sole blocker is onSuccess: the current EffectAtom has no way to express 'half of the failed-save damage roll' without lying about the dice.
